en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we talk about?
I've gotten used to being here...
I want to get outside as soon as I can...
Staying here forever wouldn't be so bad

Yeah, me too. But that doesn't change 
the fact that I wanna escape!

Life is short! I don't have time 
to waste loafing around here.
Don't get complacent!

If you start to enjoy a place like this,
then you'll never find new horizons!

Well that's obvious... 
What's really on your mind, man?

If there's something you're worried 
about, just talk to me.

Your worry is my worry!
My worry is your worry!

If I can ease your worries,
mine will be eased too!

Huh!? What the hell 
are you talking about!?
No way we're staying here forever!

Even if you are my sidekick, I won't 
let you off the hook for saying that!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kaito looks deep in thought...
(Damn it...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kaito's inner thoughts...?
